description: Performance sweep - PHP: valkey-glide-php vs phpredis (high-throughput configs). There is no bench-aws.sh version flag for this client: the valkey_glide extension is installed on the host, not pinned in the repo. phpredis is the stable yardstick, so compare GLIDE/phpredis ratios across runs to cancel instance-to-instance noise. Connections and iterations match perf-ruby. infra/provision.sh does not install the PHP runtime or the valkey_glide extension yet, so this matrix fails on bench-aws.sh until that block is added; run it locally with make benchmark-matrix.
